mapper.select: SELECT 'PUR_REQUEST' AS kind, '구매요청' AS kind_label, r.request_no AS no, r.request_seq AS seq, COALESCE(pl.plant_name, '') AS label, r.request_status AS status, 'REQUEST_STATUS' AS status_group, r.requested_at AS when, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'purchase-requests' AS route FROM tb_purchase_request r LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = r.plant_seq WHERE r.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY r.request_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PUR_ORDER' AS kind, '발주' AS kind_label, o.order_no AS no, o.order_seq AS seq, COALESCE(pt.partner_name, '') AS label, o.order_status AS status, 'PO_STATUS' AS status_group, o.created_at AS when, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'purchase-orders' AS route FROM tb_purchase_order o LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_partner pt ON pt.partner_seq = o.supplier_seq WHERE o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY o.order_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'INBOUND' AS kind, '입고' AS kind_label, i.inbound_no AS no, i.inbound_seq AS seq, COALESCE(pt.partner_name, '') AS label, i.inbound_status AS status, 'INBOUND_STATUS' AS status_group, i.created_at AS when, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'inbound-plans' AS route FROM tb_inbound i LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = i.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_partner pt ON pt.partner_seq = i.supplier_seq WHERE i.inbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY i.inbound_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'ORDER' AS kind, '주문' AS kind_label, o.order_no AS no, o.order_seq AS seq, TRIM(BOTH ' · ' FROM COALESCE(o.receiver_name, '') || ' · ' || COALESCE(o.ext_order_no, '')) AS label, o.order_status AS status, 'ORDER_STATUS' AS status_group, o.ordered_at AS when, NULL AS plant_name, 'orders' AS route FROM tb_order o WHERE o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR o.ext_order_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR o.receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR REPLACE(o.receiver_phone, '-', '') ILIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, '-', '') || '%' ORDER BY o.order_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'OUTBOUND' AS kind, '출고지시' AS kind_label, o.outbound_no AS no, o.outbound_seq AS seq, COALESCE(pl.plant_name, '') AS label, o.outbound_status AS status, 'OUTBOUND_STATUS' AS status_group, o.instructed_at AS when, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'outbounds' AS route FROM tb_outbound o LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq WHERE o.outbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY o.outbound_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'WAYBILL' AS kind, '송장' AS kind_label, w.waybill_no AS no, w.waybill_seq AS seq, COALESCE(cr.courier_name, w.courier_code) AS label, CASE WHEN w.waybill_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE w.delivery_status END AS status, CASE WHEN w.waybill_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'WAYBILL_STATUS' ELSE 'DELIVERY_STATUS' END AS status_group, w.issued_at AS when, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'delivery-track' AS route FROM tb_waybill w LEFT JOIN tb_courier cr ON cr.courier_code = w.courier_code LEFT JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq LEFT JOIN tb_outbound o ON o.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq WHERE REPLACE(w.waybill_no, '-', '') ILIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, '-', '') || '%' ORDER BY w.waybill_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'SKU' AS kind, 'SKU' AS kind_label, k.sku_id AS no, k.sku_seq AS seq, TRIM(BOTH ' / ' FROM COALESCE(pr.product_name, '') || ' / ' || COALESCE(k.color_code, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(k.size_code, '')) AS label, k.status AS status, 'SKU_STATUS' AS status_group, k.created_at AS when, NULL AS plant_name, 'stocks' AS route FROM tb_sku k LEFT JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq WHERE k.sku_id ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR k.barcode ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR pr.product_id ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR pr.product_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY k.sku_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: SELECT o.request_seq FROM tb_purchase_order o WHERE o.order_seq = #{seq}
SELECT o.request_seq FROM tb_inbound i JOIN tb_purchase_order o ON o.order_seq = i.order_seq WHERE i.inbound_seq = #{seq}
SELECT MIN(l.order_seq) FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = #{seq}

SELECT MIN(l.order_seq) FROM tb_waybill w JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq JOIN tb_outbound_line ol ON ol.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq WHERE w.waybill_seq = #{seq}

mapper.select:
SELECT 'ORDER' AS kind, '주문' AS kind_label, o.order_no AS no, o.order_seq AS seq, o.order_status AS status, 'ORDER_STATUS' AS status_group, TRIM(BOTH ' · ' FROM COALESCE(o.receiver_name, '') || ' · ' || COALESCE(o.ext_order_no, '')) AS label, (SELECT SUM(l.order_qty)::int FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq) AS qty, o.ordered_at AS when, 'orders' AS route, TRUE AS reached FROM tb_order o WHERE o.order_seq = #{orderSeq}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OUTBOUND', '출고지시', ob.outbound_no, ob.outbound_seq, ob.outbound_status, 'OUTBOUND_STATUS', COALESCE(pl.plant_name, ''), (SELECT SUM(x.instructed_qty)::int FROM tb_outbound_line x WHERE x.outbound_seq = ob.outbound_seq), ob.instructed_at, 'outbounds', TRUE FROM tb_outbound ob LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = ob.plant_seq WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = ob.outbound_seq AND l.order_seq = #{orderSeq})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAYBILL', '박스 · 송장', w.waybill_no, w.waybill_seq, CASE WHEN w.waybill_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE w.delivery_status END, CASE WHEN w.waybill_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'WAYBILL_STATUS' ELSE 'DELIVERY_STATUS' END, COALESCE(cr.courier_name, w.courier_code) || ' · ' || b.box_no || '번 박스', (SELECT SUM(bl.packed_qty)::int FROM tb_pack_box_line bl WHERE bl.box_seq = b.box_seq), COALESCE(b.handed_over_at, w.issued_at), 'delivery-track', TRUE FROM tb_waybill w JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq LEFT JOIN tb_courier cr ON cr.courier_code = w.courier_code WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq AND l.order_seq = #{orderSeq})
ORDER BY 9, 4
